The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: a place where children learn.

notes: While 'escuela' can refer to a building or an institution, it is most commonly used for primary or secondary education.
For university-level studies, native speakers more commonly use 'la universidad' or 'la facultad'.

senses.definition: A building or institution where children and teenagers go to learn.

examples.text: Los niños van a la escuela todos los días.
examples.translation: The children go to school every day.
examples.emotion: matter-of-fact and routine, describing a daily habit

senses.definition: A specific school of thought or a group of people who share the same style or philosophy.

examples.text: Él pertenece a la escuela de pensamiento existencialista.
examples.translation: He belongs to the existentialist school of thought.
examples.emotion: serious and thoughtful, discussing an academic topic
